title: The Tagged English Translated Loli Collection - 2018 edition
description:
Hello there.

Welcome to the "The Tagged English Translated Loli Collection - 2018 edition", a torrent with a wide range of translated releases up to Dec 31st, 2017 that I have been personally collecting for over 10 years. It's a big torrent so do read on while it downloads.



- Introduction 



Inside you'll find around 3.2k releases (a deceiving number since a lot of releases were compiled into tanks which only count as "1" release) and 133k~ pages. The theme is, unsurprisingly, focused on loli, but with a lot of flat chested teens and some other content slipped in (more on that later). While it might seem big, this collection isn't among the largest ones and you can find others (up to 1 tera iirc) that will be more thorough and also include untranslated releases. So why download this one? Well, the appeal of this collection can be seen below.

![](https://i.imgur.com/htS30Q6.jpg)
![](https://i.imgur.com/j9BBjSl.jpg)
![](https://i.imgur.com/Zd2lDkF.jpg)
![](https://i.imgur.com/TA2ySPu.jpg)
Mirrors:
https://a.pomfe.co/gzaazx.png
https://a.pomfe.co/kyccye.png
https://a.pomfe.co/nedzvr.png
https://a.pomfe.co/vihkme.png
(if these get deleted you can find samples inside the torrent and download only them)

As you can see, this download includes a software bundled in. Named HappyPanda, this software can sort, handle tags and do a multitude of features. Imagine a music player for doujinshi. It's features include:

>Random gallery selection
>Tag filtering
>Favorites
>Automatic parsing of tags through EX and other sites
>Etc

You can find this software separately at https://github.com/Pewpews/happypanda and use it with your own collection if you so please. I strongly recommend that you check it out and support its creator.

Now for those of you who already have a personal collection I must warn you, the software isn't perfect. The automatic parsing procedure not only takes a while but often fails, and correcting the mistakes it makes is a laborious process. Moreover, if your gallery is missing from EX or is a Fakku release then finding tags will be even more challenging (although the software does try to go around this with other sources, not always successfully) and at worst you'll have to add the tags manually.

Thus, I offer this database. My own personal collection that I decided to upload and share a couple months back. This was inspired by older loli torrents that helped shape my collection and get it started. No gallery included in this torrent is untagged and all the major issues were already straightened out by me. By downloading this torrent you'll get a complete package that will work out of the box (once you complete the lengthy installation process, details included on the README).

So what exactly is inside?



- Content 



As previously stated, inside the torrent you'll find around 3.2k releases. These include tankoubons (complete and incomplete), doujinshi old and new and also content that has been forbidden on websites like EX. Now, while the focus of the torrent is on lolicon content, you'll find a lot of releases that includes things like vanilla or big breasted women. That is usually the case of the tanks in which I deemed better to include the entire release over excluding it. That said, some regular loli content is not present simply because it wasn't part of my personal collection before I decided to make this a thing. I have my own preferences and what I find attractive might not be the same for you. For example, the only reason older Mochi's releases are not in are simply because I don't find the drawings attractive. Therefore, I recommend using this collection as a springboard to building your own, as not every artist in it will have their complete catalogues included (though I believe the majority of them do) and I strongly recommend looking up those that you find interesting.

Now onto the genres that were avoided on purpose:

>NTR
While you will find some of it in (namely those that don't fool the audience into thinking it's something else, e.g. Tanabe Kyou's Netoraregatari series), it's not something I ever sought after and I actively excluded from some releases (e.g. Okada Kou's tanks "Chu-Gakusei Diary", "Sukide Sukide, Sukide" and "A Size" are all intentionally incomplete). If this is something you are looking for then I'm sorry to say that you won't find much here.

>Overly violent / extreme content
Lolicon, just like every fetish, will have a part dedicated to some very extreme content. I'm referring here to artists like Kawady Max or others that depict very hurtful/violent physical abuse, guro or scat. This content was for the most part avoided and I'm sorry to disappoint if that's what you enjoy. That said, rape content or other less extreme fetishes weren't excluded in any way, you can fully expect the entire catalogs of artists like Yukino Minato or Quzilax.

>Softcore content
Besides some exceptions like Ke-ta, the number of releases that don't include at least penetration are very, very small (unless they are yuri, obviously).

>Unrelated images / non-story galleries
Don't expect many galleries that don't have a story of some sort in it. Some were included but only very few made it in. Textless stories were added though, and are among the few not considered "English".

More details on the README.

Finally, in order to facilitate your browsing experience, I've created some categories to help out, you can easily access them on the software.

>Complete Works (tanks)

>Editor's Choice
My personal favorites. I believe these to be the cream of the crop so I strongly recommend checking out every single one of them. We all know that taste is not a universal thing though, feel free to use the included favorite system and ignore this entirely.

>Fakku Pack
See README.

>Incomplete Tankoubons

>Vintage
A collection of older/classic releases.



- The bad and the ugly 



I will now list the problems with this torrent. These can be severe so please read on.

>Resolution issue
The largest problem of this collection is that the images you will find inside are not at their highest resolution that you can find online. I'm terribly sorry about this and if I knew I was turning my collection into a torrent back when I started I'd have avoided this entirely. That said, I don't believe the new size to be too small or a problem in enjoying the releases. I've provided an example below, please judge it yourself.
Average size you will find on a lot of the new releases in online galleries:
https://i.imgur.com/S453djJ.jpg
Mirror: https://a.pomfe.co/mhofz.png
The same page in this torrent:
https://i.imgur.com/bq0xc0o.jpg
Mirror: https://a.pomfe.co/ijvuve.jpg
If you do have these releases in your PC you will be able to replace the files and use the tagging features of the collection. That said, it will be tiresome process without some sort of image comparison software and you might as well start a collection of your own.
I'd like to add that a great part of the releases were untouched since their largest resolution were around the size of the second image from above. 
Once again, I'm sorry about this.

>Issues with tagging
The tags aren't perfect. This stems from the fact that they are based on EX's tags and those are full of issues (which I tried to iron out). Things you might consider a genre might be another, and so on. Unlike EX though, the software fully allows users to customize the tags and do with the galleries as they please.
Another issue is that the scrapping from other websites used different nomenclatures, and there are some (but not many) inconsistencies. You'll notice this the most in the Fakku releases.

>Issues with artist names
See README

>Parodies in the titles
See README

>English always chosen for title names
See README

>Happypanda itself
While I'm very thankful for it, the software is clunky. It will take some time to get adjusted to it, I have detailed this some more in the installation instructions.



- Feedback 



Thanks for reading all the way through. I put a lot of work into this torrent and I want to hear how to improve it. That's right, I do plan on making others and I do want to make this in an yearly thing, if there is enough interest. I already have 100+ galleries from this year alone which I resent not including, plus many of my older folders which I simply did not have enough time to go through.

I'll be starting a thread in a certain image board which actually holds a loli board, if you'd like to leave feedback please do it there. While I'd love to create threads in 4chan's /a/ board, this simply isn't related to it and to be honest I'd be shitting it up. 

Things I'd really love to hear about:

>Galleries that shouldn't be in
Things that have nothing to do with loli related content (or flat chests/etc, please be reasonable about this) that slipped in. Extreme content that got in is also something I'm willing to remove from future releases.

>Galleries that should be in
Any obvious artists and releases that I have missed.

>Completely off tags
See README.

>Duplicates

>Etc
Anything else goes really.



- Shout-outs 



I'd like to thank every single artist in this collection. If you like their work, please consider buying them.
I'd also like to thank every translator that has contributed to this collection. You are making the difference in making this genre broader.
I also want to thanks for Twiddly for making HappyPanda. I've been looking for a software with these capabilities for years and without it, I'd never have created this torrent. While he isn't working on HappyPanda anymore, he is working on a "sequel" software, HappyPandaX. Please consider supporting them. You can find out about their future projects here:
https://pewpew.moe/
Finally, I'd like to thank the anons on /a/. Discussing loli has always been a pleasure with you guys. Thanks for all the kind support you've given me.

Cheers,

The Loli Cataloguer
